_about: In-world dates. Files before program termination look like history; in the back half of season 1 mission dates drift past the termination date (finale twist).

events.event: Recovery Team 04's SRS beacon (registered RT-04 / HOLLOWAY) sends its last signal
events.note: FILE 001 shows the beacon and its RT-04 / HOLLOWAY tag; the official record lists it as UNREGISTERED; the 2023-08-17 date itself has not been shown on screen yet
